description: This file contains unit tests for the BinCleaningWorker component in an Android application. It tests the deletion behavior of notes based on different retention periods such as one week, two weeks, one month, and never, by setting preferences and verifying the notes are correctly deleted or retained.

classes.name: BinCleaningWorkerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the BinCleaningWorker component, ensuring that notes are correctly deleted according to different user-defined retention policies.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a test instance of BinCleaningWorker with appropriate dependencies.

methods.name: test1WeekDelete
methods.description: Tests that notes older than one week are deleted properly by the worker.

methods.name: test2WeeksDelete
methods.description: Tests that notes older than two weeks are deleted properly.

methods.name: test1MonthDelete
methods.description: Tests that notes older than one month are deleted as expected.

methods.name: testNeverDelete
methods.description: Verifies that notes are not deleted when the deletion policy is set to 'NEVER'.

methods.name: setupNotes
methods.description: Creates and inserts a predefined set of notes with varying ages into the repository for testing purposes.
